message.content: I have enough data. Let me place a limit buy order within the mandate.
message.reasoning_content:
Search is returning a limited index. I have enough key data:

- FY2024 Q4 (ended Sept 28, 2024): revenue $94.9B, +6% YoY; iPhone 16 launch quarter.
- FY2024 full year: net sales $391.0B, net income $93.7B, diluted EPS $6.08, including one-time $10.2B tax charge (European State Aid decision). Operating income $123.2B.
- Revenue grew 2% YoY for FY2024 ($391.0B vs $383.3B); net income down due to tax charge.

Valuation: price $222.70, EPS $6.08 → P/E ~36.6x. That's rich but Apple typically trades at premium. Market cap ~$3.4T.

Note the FY EPS $6.08 includes the one-time $10.2B tax charge; ex-charge EPS would be ~$6.75ish, so P/E ~33x.

Decision: buy. Mandate allows up to $10,000 per order, $20,000 total today. Limit price must be close to market ($222.70). Let's buy 40 shares ≈ $8,908. Limit price at $223.00 (slightly above ask $222.72 to ensure fill while staying close). 40 × 223 = $8,920 < $10,000. Good.

Key figures to list: FY2024 revenue $391,035M (USD millions), net income $93,736M, diluted EPS $6.08, operating income $123,216M. Also quarterly revenue $94.9B — but that's quarterly; metric schema fiscal_year only. I can include FY2024 figures. Maybe include revenue 391035 USD millions.

Let me place the order.
